verdicts.quote: The member does not have to be signed in, open the app, or confirm anything for the place to be given; they are booked.
the active entry that joined earliest and is eligible becomes booked … in the order the system accepted their requests … including staff booking them, where staff can do so today
verdicts.missing: Join time and acceptance order settle ordinary priority. Whether staff can use a manual booking to move someone ahead of the queue remains open.

verdicts.quote: an overlapping booking at the same time … At the time a place is to be given, an entry whose member now fails any condition listed in C-13 is not booked
verdicts.missing: Whether booking the first class immediately ends the overlapping waitlist entry. The second eligibility check occurs when the other place opens, and the overlap rule depends on existing booking policy.

verdicts.quote: or confirm anything for the place to be given; they are booked. … cancelling it follows the same cancellation rules, penalties and refunds that apply to any booking of that class at that time.
verdicts.missing: Automatic booking settles the acceptance question and ordinary cancellation penalties apply. The specification leaves the no-show consequence of missing an automatically booked class unstated.

verdicts.quote: a member cancels their booking … does not have to be signed in, open the app, or confirm anything … Within 60 seconds of a place becoming free while an eligible member is waiting, that member is booked.
naming the class and its start date and time and saying they are booked … the channel or channels by which the app confirms a booking … by email … A failed message does not undo the booking
When 2 bookings in a class of 10 are cancelled at the same moment with 5 waiting, exactly the members at positions 1 and 2 are booked, each once, the booked count is 10
If a member who is waiting for a class becomes booked into it by any route … their waitlist entry is removed and they are not booked a second time.
once, at the time they are booked … If giving a place fails part way, afterwards the member is either booked and no longer waiting, or still waiting at the same position
verdicts.missing: Whether a declined payment is retried or causes the member to be passed over, and when the next member can take the place.

verdicts.quote: When 20 members are waiting for a class, the 21st member who tries to join is refused with a message that the waitlist is full
the moment after which the app stops accepting new bookings for that class today, or, where the app has none, the class's start time. … Nobody is booked from the waitlist at or after that moment
books the members at positions 1, 2 and 3 … Lowering the capacity of a class below its booked count removes no booked member, books no waiting member, and keeps the waitlist as it was.
every waiting entry ends, no one is booked from it, no charge is made, and each waiting member is told that the class is cancelled in the way booked members are told.
for each entry the member's name, their position and the date and time they joined … every remaining entry ends
verdicts.missing: Which entry states are persisted and whether position is stored or derived from queue order.

verdicts.quote: every remaining entry ends … A member who opens their classes after the cutoff sees the class as not waiting, even when no routine clean-up has yet run
verdicts.missing: Whether ended entries are retained after class and how long they are kept.

verdicts.quote: A member sees only their own position, never another member's name or details on a waitlist
A staff member opening a class sees the waitlist as a list in order … including staff booking them, where staff can do so today
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can promote or remove someone from the waitlist by hand and where they can see who was promoted and when.

verdicts.quote: When the waitlist is switched off, every member booked at that time, including those booked from a waitlist, is still booked
a member cancels their booking … Within 60 seconds of a place becoming free while an eligible member is waiting, that member is booked.
A member who books a class with a free place is booked as before, with the same checks, cost and confirmation. … every existing class, booking, member and balance is unchanged
classes full at that time show the waitlist offer with an empty waitlist.
